leadStory: Andoni Iraola names a Liverpool team for the first time tonight, a young, half-assembled side opening the American tour against Sunderland in Nashville, the first sight of the new era.
subject: A floodlit stadium at night, a lone manager standing in an empty technical area on the touchline, the pitch bright and waiting before kick-off
prompt: Cinematic editorial photograph, night, a vast dark grandstand under a bank of cold white floodlights, an empty green pitch tilting up and glowing, a single figure in a dark coat standing alone in the technical area on the near touchline, small in a wide frame, his long shadow thrown forward across the turf, a faint warm dawn glow rising at the base against the cool floodlight, film grain, a quiet sense of a beginning, no on-image text, headroom at the top for a masthead headline
